Figure 1:An instance of ourMeta-Agent w/ Archivepipeline. The environmentEEis a sandboxed container with a filesystem. The base environment containing benchmark-specific artifacts such as tools and corpora is shared across study and test time.
Before test time, the meta-agent exploresEEunder budgetBstudyB_{\mathrm{study}}, using strategies from a mounted archive. It writes study artifacts into a volume that is later mounted into the test-time agent’s sandbox. The test-time agent uses the study artifacts and the pre-existing benchmark-specific artifacts to solve unseen tasks.
